phrase.zh: 多看一眼，发现藏在细节里。
phrase.en: Look again; discovery lives in the details.

visual.zh: 大幅培养皿偏向右侧，右上方不规则菌落周围留出空白圈，细小斑点分布在圈外；透明皿边与浅影由细刻线描绘。
visual.en: A large plate sits toward the right, with an irregular upper-right colony surrounded by a clear ring and tiny flecks beyond it; fine etched lines draw its transparent rim and light shadow.

background.zh:
弗莱明在1928年注意到，培养皿里霉菌周围的细菌生长受到抑制。他随后研究了霉菌产生的物质，并将其命名为青霉素。弗莱明、钱恩与弗洛里共同获得1945年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，各占三分之一。画面以霉菌周围的空白圈表达这次观察，是原创示意，不是真实标本、测量结果或用药建议。短句为原创。
1945年生理学或医学奖；获得本年度奖项的三分之一。获奖理由（中文译述）：发现青霉素及其对多种感染性疾病的治疗作用
background.en:
In 1928, Fleming noticed inhibited bacterial growth around mould in a culture plate. He investigated the substance the mould produced and named it penicillin. Fleming, Chain and Florey shared the 1945 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, each receiving one third. A clear ring around a mould colony expresses that observation in an original illustration, not an actual specimen, measurement or treatment advice. The phrase is original.
1945 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received one-third of the prize. Official motivation: for the discovery of penicillin and its curative effect in various infectious diseases
